req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should accept POST requests to create tasks without a description field. This implies that the description field is optional. The test suite will include a positive test to verify that a task can be created without a description, a negative test to ensure that missing required fields result in an error, and a boundary test to check the behavior when the description is exactly at its maximum length.

tests.name: test_create_task_without_description
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload that includes only the title and completed fields.
expected: The response payload contains the task with the correct title and completed status.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "Test Task", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Test Task"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
assert "description" not in response.json()

tests.name: test_create_task_missing_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload that omits the title field.
expected: The response contains a validation error indicating that the title field is required.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]
assert response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"] == "field required"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_max_length_description
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload that includes a title and a description of exactly 500 characters.
expected: The response payload contains the task with the correct title and description.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_description = "d" * 500
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "Boundary Test Task", "description": max_length_description, "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Boundary Test Task"
assert response.json()["description"] == max_length_description
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
